## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Scope and interfaces

List affected modules, producer/consumer agreements, and compatibility impact.
Link the task record in docs/changes/ and any relevant ADR.

## Validation

Give commands, results, and the tested revision. Identify skipped or fake-backed checks.

## Integration

- [ ] The branch targets main without direct development on main.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass and the task record is current.
- [ ] Project status is updated if delivered capabilities or priorities change.
- [ ] Public interface consumers, tests, and docs are updated together.
- [ ] Cleanup and rollback are described where applicable.
